Container.Name: SeerrNG
Container.Overview: Self-hosted requests and discovery for movies, TV, music, books, comics, magazines, ROMs, and PC games, with optional integrations including BookshelfNG, Mylar3, Kapowarr, LazyLibrarian, ROMarrNG, and QuestarrNG.
Container.Description: SeerrNG extends the Seerr request workflow to music, ebooks, audiobooks, comics, magazines, ROMs, and PC games. This Community Apps template installs SeerrNG itself. BookshelfNG, ROMarrNG, and QuestarrNG are optional standalone NG forks with their own repositories and Unraid templates; they also work without SeerrNG. LazyLibrarian, Mylar3, and Kapowarr are third-party apps with existing Community Apps listings, not Snapetech forks. Install only the optional services you use and configure their integrations in SeerrNG. See https://github.com/snapetech-org/seerrng/blob/main/docs/getting-started/third-parties/unraid.mdx for the companion template links. A one-project Compose alternative is available at https://github.com/snapetech-org/seerrng/tree/main/packaging/unraid. Comic requests target full volumes, with older issue searches handled by Mylar3 or Kapowarr. This template uses the latest stable GHCR image and persists the database, settings, logs, cache, and TLS material under /app/config. The image intentionally runs as the non-root node user with UID 1000 and GID 1000, so the mapped host directory must be writable by that UID and GID. Configure built-in HTTPS from Settings > Network; the optional HTTPS listener is exposed on port 5056. Use a reverse proxy for public access rather than exposing the administration interface directly to the Internet.

Container.Requires: Requires Docker, network access for metadata and external service integrations, and a persistent host directory for /app/config. Set the host directory ownership to UID 1000 and GID 1000 before the first start because the image does not run as root.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the SeerrNG web interface.

Config.Name: HTTPS Port
Config.Description: HTTPS listener port when built-in TLS is enabled in Settings > Network.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent database, settings, logs, image cache, and TLS material. Make this host directory writable by UID 1000 and GID 1000.

Config.Name: TMDB API Key Override
Config.Description: Optional override. SeerrNG includes a default TMDB key; leave blank unless you need to use your own v3 API key.

Config.Name: TMDB Read Access Token Override
Config.Description: Optional v4 bearer-token override. SeerrNG includes a default TMDB key; leave blank unless you need to use your own token. This takes precedence over the v3 API key override.

Config.Name: Metrics Enabled
Config.Description: Set to true to enable the Prometheus /metrics endpoint.

Config.Name: Metrics Auth Token
Config.Description: Optional bearer token required by /metrics when metrics are enabled.

Config.Name: Require Public Setup Hosts
Config.Description: Set to true to reject private or LAN Jellyfin and Emby hostnames during first-run setup.

Config.Name: Allow Private Notification URLs
Config.Description: Set to true only when notification receivers such as Discord, Slack, webhooks, ntfy, or Gotify are intentionally hosted on the LAN.

Config.Name: Allow Private Push Endpoints
Config.Description: Set to true only when browser push subscription endpoints are intentionally private or internal.

Config.Name: External Services Read Only
Config.Description: Set to true to block mutating requests to external automation services. Production also requires the explicit production override below.

Config.Name: Allow Production Read Only
Config.Description: Explicitly allows read-only external-service mode in production when SEERR_EXTERNAL_READ_ONLY is true.

Config.Name: Skip Database Migrations
Config.Description: Set to true only when database migrations are run out of band.
